name: Anna Eilers
story: The published 2018 New Zealand Esri User Conference programme names Anna Eilers as facilitator for local and regional government and transportation sessions. It places her in the user-conference programme and the practitioner exchange around local-government GIS.

sources.label: Eagle Technology, NZEUC 2018 final programme, updated 14 August 2018
